title: Replace Airtable: Build Your Own Database Tool With AI in an Afternoon
summary: Airtable costs $20-54/seat/month. Build your own custom database tool with AI in an afternoon — with the exact features your team needs and none you don't.
body_markdown: The honest answer depends on why you're leaving. If per-seat pricing is the problem, a custom-built tool is the most economical path — database automatically included in Blink, no Supabase account needed. If you want a drop-in SaaS alternative, Notion databases, Baserow (open source), or NocoDB cover most Airtable use cases at lower cost. None of them solve the per-seat pricing problem the way owning your platform does.
